response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS award_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), totals AS (SELECT NULLIF(SUM(award_count), 0) AS total_count FROM award_counts) SELECT ac.player_id, ac.award_count, 1.0 * ac.award_count / t.total_count AS fraction FROM award_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, ac.player_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: When there are no manager awards, the zero denominator makes every fraction undefined, so the query returns no rows.
